description: This Java class is a command handler within the Fineract project responsible for handling the rejection of additional shares for a share account. It receives commands, processes them, and delegates the rejection operation to the ShareAccountWritePlatformService.

classes.name: RejectAddtionalSharesCommandHandler
classes.description: A Spring service class that handles commands for rejecting additional shares on a share account, implementing the NewCommandSourceHandler interface.

methods.name: RejectAddtionalSharesCommandHandler
methods.description: Constructor that injects the ShareAccountWritePlatformService dependency.

methods.name: processCommand
methods.description: Processes the incoming JSON command to reject additional shares by delegating to the shareAccountWritePlatformService.
